name: Bonnie
source:
A tired, overworked young maid. Having spent her short life mindlessly working herself to the bone, Bonnie is suddenly thrust into Cassiopeia's schemes, and as things at the mansion take a turn of the worse, can she find happiness with the girl of her dreams?
[From [url=https://punishedhag.itch.io/the-endless-together]itch.io[/url]]
